description: For a seller about to list: suggested ask, floor, and ceiling for their bike's brand+model[+year][+condition] on the UK market. Same measured UK used-price data as get_valuation but framed as seller guidance. Pass `year` when the seller names one — the ask is then anchored on that model year's own median rather than the all-years median. Example: 'I'm selling a 2021 Specialized Allez in good condition — what should I ask?'.

year.description: Model year, e.g. 2021. Optional. Anchors the ask on that year when the curve covers it; `basis` in the response always names what the ask was actually derived from.

name: suggest_listing_price
